<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

nltl:TRF035QuantityValueShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "The quantity must contain exactly one decimal numericValue." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M> ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "The quantity must contain exactly one metre unit (http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M)." ;
    ] ;
    sh:description "Quantity representation for TRF-035 clause 4.1.1. Canonical serialization uses qudt:numericValue as xsd:decimal and qudt:unit as an IRI." ;
    sh:sourceConstraint [
        sh:description "Source: data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt; document SHA-256 e0bf179c97a1535aa7d4d0dd5d4053edf5f3f4e7e028c49d14c3a31cc7c1e8ba; selected parent/context section 4.1.1 range 42109-43429; selection SHA-256 bcccb0c27b3065f7270ed4809b69f39fcbcc051291a324f43641bf09a19a7c90." ;
    ] .

nltl:TRF035ShipShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:description "TRF-035, Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof, clause 4.1.1: “L shall be taken as the ship's rule length used by the classification society.” This shape is activated for the caller-admitted complete population of nltl:ship records. External population eligibility and source-edition selection remain caller attestations." ;
    sh:sourceConstraint [
        sh:description "Source: data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt; document SHA-256 e0bf179c97a1535aa7d4d0dd5d4053edf5f3f4e7e028c49d14c3a31cc7c1e8ba; selection start 42109, end 43429; section 4.1.1; selection SHA-256 bcccb0c27b3065f7270ed4809b69f39fcbcc051291a324f43641bf09a19a7c90; source-selection manifest SHA-256 822f145b3babe4eda153f2cd35c0f0ad6bb5a09509838ba9214f729daad723ea." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:classificationSociety ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:string ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "A ship must identify the classification society associated with the rule length used for L." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:ruleLength ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:node nltl:TRF035QuantityValueShape ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "A ship must have exactly one ruleLength quantity encoded as a metre-valued QUDT QuantityValue." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:classificationSocietyRuleLength ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:node nltl:TRF035QuantityValueShape ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "A ship must have exactly one separately supplied classificationSocietyRuleLength quantity encoded as a metre-valued QUDT QuantityValue." ;
    ] ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "ruleLength must equal classificationSocietyRuleLength in both decimal metre value and unit." ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:ruleLength ?ruleQuantity ;
                      nltl:classificationSocietyRuleLength ?societyQuantity .

                ?ruleQuantity qudt:numericValue ?ruleValue ;
                              qudt:unit ?ruleUnit .

                ?societyQuantity qudt:numericValue ?societyValue ;
                                 qudt:unit ?societyUnit .

                FILTER (
                    xsd:decimal(?ruleValue) != xsd:decimal(?societyValue)
                    || ?ruleUnit != ?societyUnit
                )
            }
        """ ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
